"""UNRUN operational draft. Root must bind/review the concrete publication first.

Only stdlib orchestration here. TESTs, gate, reader and product execute solely in
the four literal children from the separately reviewed candidate command plan.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath, PureWindowsPath
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


PLAN_SHA = "525ac556548ed30e62cc82f2ea0d6c3973af3bc3e4870f66ec8fdb9ac7854540"
MAP_SHA = "11c4741b7b544c89d30f2f2536558d3480f9fe968086d794fc6db2d0eb667b01"
ASSET_COUNT = 49
CONFIG_PATH = "tldw_chatbook/config.py"
CONFIG_BEFORE = "096361f6c4255a49646d3b9383282ed180bd82cde90caf4b376b9ba8e840c960"
CONFIG_AFTER = "da3a1d55cc080bd193fe1a37a04ae5f4fc83d8d5cb9bb78a05fa13135b4ce026"
ARTIFACT_NAME = "pr3023-opt36-candidate-r1"


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def digest(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value)


def relative(root, name):
    assert isinstance(name, str) and "\\" not in name
    parts = PurePosixPath(name)
    assert name and not parts.is_absolute() and all(p not in ("", ".", "..") for p in parts.parts)
    target = root.joinpath(*parts.parts).resolve()
    assert target.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) and target != root.resolve()
    return target


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", "gc.auto=0", *args], cwd=root).decode().strip()


def sources(root):
    # Exact Root predicate, including declared untracked Python files. No rglob.
    names = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", "gc.auto=0", "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], cwd=root)
    return {name: sha(relative(root, name)) for name in sorted(set(names.decode().split("\0")) - {""})
            if name.endswith(".py") and relative(root, name).is_file()}


def non_python(root, binding):
    rows = binding["non_python_guards"]
    assert rows and len({r["logical_path"] for r in rows}) == len(rows)
    for row in rows:
        path = relative(root, row["logical_path"])
        assert not row["logical_path"].endswith(".py")
        assert path.is_file() and digest(row["sha256"]) and sha(path) == row["sha256"]
    assert binding["native_asset_inventory_review_sha256"] and digest(binding["native_asset_inventory_review_sha256"])
    for name in ("pytest.ini", "setup.cfg"):
        assert not relative(root, name).exists()


def identity(root, binding):
    assert binding["status"] == "ROOT_BOUND_AND_INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED"
    assert digest(binding["packet_manifest_sha256"]) and digest(binding["packet_zip_sha256"])
    assert digest(binding["reader_test_review_sha256"]) and digest(binding["operational_review_sha256"])
    assert all(isinstance(binding[name], str) and len(binding[name]) == 40 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in binding[name])
               for name in ("publication_parent", "goal_snapshot_origin_commit"))
    assert binding["goal_snapshot_origin_commit"] == binding["publication_parent"]
    assert binding["workflow_path"] == ".github/workflows/console-pause-native-evidence.yml"
    assert git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]
    assert git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^") == binding["publication_parent"]
    changed = git(root, "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD^", "HEAD").splitlines()
    assert changed == binding["changed_paths"] and changed == sorted(set(changed))
    assert binding["workflow_path"] in changed and binding["packet_zip_path"] in changed
    assert not git(root, "diff", "HEAD", "--name-only")
    non_python(root, binding)
    return {"head": os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"], "parent": binding["publication_parent"],
            "goal_snapshot_origin_commit": binding["goal_snapshot_origin_commit"], "changed_paths": changed,
            "runtime_mechanism_origin_only": "f6bb9fba4a707dfeb4491ffa9903a52086424f6a",
            "scope": "Exact Root-supplied selected Goal snapshot; runtime acquisition head is not the product baseline."}


def packet_check(packet, binding):
    assert sha(packet / "manifest.json") == binding["packet_manifest_sha256"]
    manifest = read(packet / "manifest.json")
    rows = manifest["assets"]
    assert len(rows) == ASSET_COUNT
    assert len({r["path"] for r in rows}) == ASSET_COUNT
    expected = {r["path"] for r in rows} | {"manifest.json"}
    actual = {p.relative_to(packet).as_posix() for p in packet.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    assert actual == expected
    for row in rows:
        path = relative(packet, row["path"])
        assert not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_size == row["bytes"] and sha(path) == row["sha256"]
    assert sha(packet / "source-map-selected-r4.json") == MAP_SHA
    assert sha(packet / "candidate-command-plan.json") == PLAN_SHA
    return read(packet / "candidate-command-plan.json"), read(packet / "source-map-selected-r4.json")


def initialize(root, archive, binding_path, expected_binding):
    assert digest(expected_binding) and sha(binding_path) == expected_binding
    binding = read(binding_path)
    assert sha(Path(__file__).resolve()) == binding["outer_sha256"]
    assert archive.is_relative_to((Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"]) / ".config").resolve()) and not archive.is_relative_to(root)
    archive.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    provenance = archive / "provenance"
    provenance.mkdir()
    shutil.copyfile(binding_path, provenance / "binding.json")
    shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__), archive / "outer.py")
    try:
        write(archive / "checkout.json", identity(root, binding))
        for row in binding["non_python_guards"]:
            target = relative(provenance / "source-anchors", row["logical_path"])
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(relative(root, row["logical_path"]), target)
        zipped = relative(root, binding["packet_zip_path"])
        assert sha(zipped) == binding["packet_zip_sha256"]
        shutil.copyfile(zipped, provenance / "packet.zip")
        packet = archive / "packet"
        packet.mkdir()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zipped) as stream:
            entries = stream.infolist()
            assert len(entries) == ASSET_COUNT + 1 and len({e.filename for e in entries}) == len(entries)
            assert all(not e.is_dir() and (e.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000 != 0o120000 for e in entries)
            assert sum(e.file_size for e in entries) < 8_000_000
            for entry in entries:
                target = relative(packet, entry.filename)
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with target.open("xb") as output:
                    output.write(stream.read(entry))
        plan, selected = packet_check(packet, binding)
        initial = sources(root)
        write(archive / "sources-initial.json", initial)
        assert len(selected) == 8479 and initial == selected
        assert len(plan["stage"]) == 2 and len(plan["products_staged"]) == 1
        product = plan["products_staged"][0]
        assert product["logical_path"] == CONFIG_PATH
        assert product["before_sha256"] == selected[CONFIG_PATH] == CONFIG_BEFORE
        assert product["sha256"] == CONFIG_AFTER
        assert sha(relative(packet, product["source"])) == CONFIG_AFTER
        for row in plan["stage"]:
            assert row["logical_path"] not in selected and not relative(root, row["logical_path"]).exists()
        roles = []
        for row in read(packet / "expected-sources.json")["sources"]:
            name = row["logical_path"]
            if name in {r["logical_path"] for r in plan["stage"]}:
                role, before_sha = "temporary_absent_TEST_creation", None
            elif name == CONFIG_PATH:
                role, before_sha = "temporary_config_replacement", CONFIG_BEFORE
                assert row["sha256"] == CONFIG_AFTER
            else:
                role, before_sha = "unchanged_current_source", row["sha256"]
            if before_sha is not None:
                assert sha(relative(root, name)) == before_sha
            roles.append({"logical_path": name, "role": role, "checkout_before_sha256": before_sha,
                          "reader_expected_staged_sha256": row["sha256"]})
        write(archive / "declared-source-roles.json", roles)
        write(archive / "initialized.json", {"ok": True, "binding_sha256": expected_binding,
              "packet_asset_rows": ASSET_COUNT, "physical_packet_files": ASSET_COUNT + 1, "python_rows": 8479})
    except BaseException:
        write(archive / "initialization-error.json", {"traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
        raise
    finally:
        artifacts(archive)


def runtime(packet, archive):
    assert os.name == "nt" and sys.platform == "win32" and sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 12, 10) and not sys.flags.optimize
    wanted = read(packet / "runtime-binding.json")
    assert importlib.metadata.version("pytest") == wanted["pytest"] == "8.4.2"
    assert importlib.metadata.version("textual") == wanted["textual"] == "8.2.8"
    rows = []
    for row in wanted["sources"]:
        module = importlib.import_module(row["module"])
        path, spec = Path(module.__file__).resolve(), module.__spec__
        loader = type(spec.loader).__module__ + "." + type(spec.loader).__qualname__
        assert PureWindowsPath(path) == PureWindowsPath(spec.origin) == PureWindowsPath(row["runtime_path"])
        assert loader == row["loader_type"] and sha(path) == row["sha256"] and path.stat().st_size == row["bytes"]
        rows.append(dict(row, actual_path=str(path), spec_origin=spec.origin, actual_loader=loader))
    assert len(rows) == 3
    assert not any(name == "tldw_chatbook" or name.startswith("tldw_chatbook.") for name in sys.modules)
    write(archive / "runtime-actual.json", {"python": sys.version, "executable": sys.executable,
          "platform": platform.platform(), "pytest": wanted["pytest"], "textual": wanted["textual"], "sources": rows,
          "scope": "Fresh file/path/spec/version check; callable/native qualification belongs to real child gates."})


def cases(path, expected, plan):
    document = ET.parse(path)
    result = list(document.iter("testcase"))
    assert [(c.get("classname"), c.get("name")) for c in result] == [
        (plan["xml_expected"][n]["classname"], plan["xml_expected"][n]["name"]) for n in expected]
    suites = list(document.iter("testsuite"))
    assert len(suites) == 1 and int(suites[0].get("tests")) == len(result)
    for attribute, tag in (("failures", "failure"), ("errors", "error"), ("skipped", "skipped")):
        assert int(suites[0].get(attribute)) == sum(c.find(tag) is not None for c in result)
    return result


def passed(case):
    return all(case.find(tag) is None for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped"))


def observer(document, expected_count, nodeid, properties, packet):
    assert document["observer_errors"] == []
    observation = document["observation"]
    assert isinstance(observation, dict) and observation["gate"]["original_fixture_callback_observed"] is False
    expected_sources = {r["module"]: r["sha256"] for r in read(packet / "expected-sources.json")["sources"]}
    expected_sources.update({r["module"]: r["sha256"] for r in read(packet / "runtime-binding.json")["sources"]})
    actual_sources = {r["module"]: r["sha256"] for r in observation["gate"]["sources"]}
    assert len(actual_sources) == len(observation["gate"]["sources"])
    assert all(expected_sources[name] == value for name, value in actual_sources.items())
    assert actual_sources["tldw_chatbook.config"] == CONFIG_AFTER
    capture = observation["adapter_capture"]
    assert capture["factory_present_at_runtime"] is False and capture["reader_invoked_factory_checker_or_producer"] is False
    assert capture["independently_compiled_actual_closures"] is True
    assert capture["helper_qualname"] == "_bind_user_data_dir_stamps.<locals>._user_data_dir_stamps"
    assert capture["checker_qualname"] == "_bind_user_data_dir_stamps.<locals>.source_current"
    assert (capture["function_records"], capture["fixed_bindings"], capture["cached_receivers"], capture["canonical_modules"]) == (25, 39, 3, 3)
    name = nodeid.split("::")[1].split("[")[0]
    parameter = nodeid.rsplit("[", 1)[1][:-1] if "[" in nodeid else None
    held = name == "test_actual_batch_return_or_projection_source_change_discards_whole_sample"
    retained = name == "test_shipping_helper_propagates_exact_retained_native_close"
    empty = name == "test_empty_and_missing_descendants_preserve_original_positions_without_optional_empty_work"
    observed = observation["native_observers"]
    assert len(observed) == expected_count
    for index, row in enumerate(observed):
        births = row["births"]
        assert not row["excluded"] and row["actual_monitor_retired"] is True
        assert [birth["ordinal"] for birth in births] == list(range(len(births)))
        assert all(b["status"] >= 0 and b["thread"] == observation["caller"] for b in births)
        if empty and index == 0:
            assert not births and not row["errors"] and row["pending_births"] == 0
            assert row["close_birth_ordinals"] == [] and row["counts"] == {} and row["security"] == []
            continue
        assert births
        if retained:
            assert row["errors"] == ["native-birth-not-retired-once", "post-drain-handle-still-valid"] and row["pending_births"] == 1
            detail = json.loads(properties["retained_close_without_fallback_or_retry"])
            cleanup = json.loads(properties["retained_fixture_finally_retired"])
            outcome, api = parameter.split("-")
            assert detail["outcome"] == cleanup["outcome"] == outcome and detail["api"] == cleanup["api"] == api
            assert detail["native_close_attempts_for_exact_owner"] == cleanup["original_close_attempts"] == detail["helper_entries"] == 1
            assert detail["scalar_fallbacks_after_error"] == 0
            assert all(detail[key] is True for key in ("same_failed_owner", "protected_physical_owner_still_valid",
                "same_actual_cause_context_suppression", "original_traceback_tail_preserved", "same_shipping_error_object"))
            failed = [b for b in births if b["closes"] != [[True, 0]]]
            assert len(failed) == 1 and failed[0]["handle"] == cleanup["continuous_handle"]
            assert cleanup["fixture_unprotected_then_native_closed"] is True and cleanup["native_invalid_error"] == 6
            assert detail["births"] == len(births) and detail["observer_retention_expected_not_retirement_claim"] == row["errors"]
            if outcome == "raising":
                assert failed[0]["closes"] == []
                expected_closed = [b["ordinal"] for b in births if b is not failed[0]]
            else:
                assert outcome == "protected_false" and len(failed[0]["closes"]) == 1
                assert failed[0]["closes"][0][0] is False and failed[0]["closes"][0][1] != 0
                expected_closed = list(range(len(births)))
            assert sorted(row["close_birth_ordinals"]) == expected_closed
        else:
            assert row["pending_births"] == 0
            if held and parameter in {"batch_body", "batch_defaults"}:
                assert row["errors"] in ([], ["source-changed"])
            else:
                assert row["errors"] == []
            assert sorted(row["close_birth_ordinals"]) == list(range(len(births)))
            assert all(b["closes"] == [[True, 0]] for b in births)
            assert row["security"] and all(security[0] and security[1] for security in row["security"])
    shipping = observation["shipping_observers"]
    assert all(row["errors"] == [] and row["monitor_retired"] is True for row in shipping)
    if held:
        assert len(shipping) == 1
        active = shipping[0]
        boundary = json.loads(properties["actual_shipping_source_boundary"])
        expected_checkpoint = ["projection" if parameter == "projection" else "batch-return"]
        assert active["returns"] == 1 and active["changed"] is True and active["drains"]
        assert active["false_checkpoints"] == boundary["genuine_false_checkpoints"] == expected_checkpoint
        assert active["restored_at_false_return"] is boundary["original_slots_restored_before_false_was_consumed"] is True
        assert boundary["change"] == parameter and boundary["mutation_fired"] is True and boundary["actual_batch_returns"] == 1
        assert boundary["physical_drains_before_change"] == active["drains"]
        assert boundary["scalar_calls_after_batch"] == active["starts"].get("posture", 0) == 0
        assert boundary["observer_errors"] == [] and boundary["native_source_errors"] == observed[0]["errors"]
    if name == "test_shipping_large_descriptor_uses_original_scalar_only_after_physical_drain":
        assert len(shipping) == 1
        positive = json.loads(properties["shipping_descriptor_fallback_after_original_drain"])
        assert positive["postures_equal"] is True and positive["actual_batch_errors"] == positive["helper_entries"] == 1
        assert positive["original_error"] == ["PermissionError", 13, "windows_admission_descriptor_unavailable"]
        assert positive["physical_drain_before_scalar"] == shipping[0]["drains"] and len(shipping[0]["drains"]) == 1
        assert positive["counts"] == observed[0]["counts"] and positive["native_births"] == len(observed[0]["births"])
        assert len(positive["original_scalar_paths"]) == 2 and positive["original_scalar_paths"][0] == positive["original_scalar_paths"][1]
    if name == "test_shipping_helper_uses_one_fresh_batch_after_equal_values_and_retirement":
        positive = json.loads(properties["shipping_causal_before_schedule_assert"])
        native = observed[0]
        assert positive["five_field_values_equal"] is positive["same_order_duplicate"] is True and positive["observer_errors"] == []
        assert positive["counts"] == positive["expected_batch_counts"] == native["counts"]
        assert positive["births_retired_once"] == len(native["births"]) and positive["ancestry"] == native["ancestry"]
        assert positive["caller"] == observation["caller"]
    return observation


def assess(command, directory, receipt, plan, archive):
    nodes = command["expected_nodeids"]
    gates = [read(path) for path in sorted((directory / "gates").glob("*.json"))]
    assert len(gates) == command["expected_gates"]
    if command["mode"] == "collection":
        found = [line.strip() for line in (directory / "stdout.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                 if line.strip().startswith("Tests/") and "::" in line]
        assert found == nodes and receipt["returncode"] == 0
        return {"classification": "EXACT_COLLECTION", "nodeids": found, "gates": 0}
    parent_cases = cases(directory / "pytest.xml", nodes, plan)
    assert receipt["returncode"] == 0 and all(passed(case) for case in parent_cases)
    parents = [g for g in gates if g["pid"] == receipt["pid"]]
    assert [g["nodeid"] for g in sorted(parents, key=lambda g: nodes.index(g["nodeid"]))] == nodes
    assert all(g["parent_pid"] == os.getpid() and g["private_profile_node_marker"] is None for g in parents)
    children = [g for g in gates if g["pid"] != receipt["pid"]]
    assert len(children) == command["expected_private_profile_child_cases"]
    child_receipts = []
    for document in parents:
        index = nodes.index(document["nodeid"])
        assert document["reports_before_teardown_result"] == [{"when": "setup", "outcome": "passed"}, {"when": "call", "outcome": "passed"}]
        name = document["nodeid"].split("::")[1].split("[")[0]
        expected = 0
        if command["group"] == "candidate31":
            if name in {"test_shipping_helper_uses_one_fresh_batch_after_equal_values_and_retirement",
                        "test_actual_batch_return_or_projection_source_change_discards_whole_sample",
                        "test_shipping_large_descriptor_uses_original_scalar_only_after_physical_drain",
                        "test_shipping_helper_propagates_exact_retained_native_close"}:
                expected = 1
            elif name == "test_direct_custom_posture_keeps_original_dispatch_before_optional_work":
                expected = int(not document["nodeid"].endswith(("[function]", "[callable]")))
            elif name == "test_empty_and_missing_descendants_preserve_original_positions_without_optional_empty_work":
                expected = 2
        properties = {p.get("name"): p.get("value") for p in parent_cases[index].findall("properties/property")}
        observation = observer(document, expected, document["nodeid"], properties, archive / "packet")
        assert observation["private_profile_child"] is False and observation["launcher"]["actual_main_stack_observed"] is True
        for child in observation["private_profile_children"]:
            assert type(child["pid"]) is int and child["pid"] > 0 and child["returncode"] == 0 and child["original_timeout"] == 180
            xml, log, work, profile = (Path(child[key]).resolve() for key in ("xml", "log", "work", "profile"))
            assert all(p.is_relative_to(archive) for p in (xml, log, work, profile))
            assert xml.is_file() and log.is_file() and work.is_dir() and profile.is_dir()
            assert passed(cases(xml, [document["nodeid"]], plan)[0])
            matching = [g for g in children if g["pid"] == child["pid"] and g["nodeid"] == document["nodeid"]]
            assert len(matching) == 1
            inner = matching[0]
            assert inner["nodeid"] == document["nodeid"] == inner["private_profile_node_marker"]
            assert inner["parent_pid"] == receipt["pid"]
            assert inner["reports_before_teardown_result"] == [{"when": "setup", "outcome": "passed"}, {"when": "call", "outcome": "passed"}]
            actual = observer(inner, 0, document["nodeid"], {}, archive / "packet")
            assert actual["private_profile_child"] is True and not actual["private_profile_children"] and actual["memo_resolver_callbacks"]
            assert actual["launcher"]["spec_name"] == "pytest.__main__"
            child_receipts.append(child)
    assert len(child_receipts) == len(children)
    return {"classification": "CANDIDATE_COHORT_PASS_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW",
            "parent_cases": len(parent_cases), "child_cases": len(children), "gates": len(gates), "children": child_receipts}


def child(command, root, packet, archive, plan):
    fields = {"python": sys.executable, "checkout_root": str(root), "packet_root": str(packet),
              "archive": str(archive), "pathsep": os.pathsep}
    directory = Path(command["archive"].format(**fields)).resolve()
    assert directory.is_relative_to(archive)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (directory / "gates").mkdir()
    argv = [part.format(**fields) for part in command["argv"]]
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    for name in plan["environment_remove"]:
        environment.pop(name, None)
    for source in (plan["environment"], command["environment"]):
        environment.update({key: value.format(**fields) for key, value in source.items()})
    receipt = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "parent_pid": os.getpid(), "started": False,
               "environment_overrides": {key: environment[key] for key in plan["environment"]}, "waited": False}
    process = None
    try:
        with (directory / "stdout.log").open("wb") as out, (directory / "stderr.log").open("wb") as err:
            process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, env=environment, stdout=out, stderr=err)
            receipt.update(started=True, pid=process.pid)
            # Start receipt stays inside the ownership/cleanup try.
            write(directory / "process.json", receipt)
            receipt["returncode"] = process.wait()
            receipt["waited"] = True
            receipt["poll"] = process.poll()
    finally:
        if process is not None:
            try:
                if not receipt["waited"]:
                    if process.poll() is None:
                        try:
                            process.terminate()
                            receipt["cleanup_terminated"] = True
                        except BaseException:
                            receipt["terminate_error"] = traceback.format_exc()
                    receipt["cleanup_returncode"] = process.wait()
                    receipt["waited"] = True
                    receipt["waited_in_cleanup"] = True
            finally:
                receipt["final_poll"] = process.poll()
                receipt["direct_child_handle_scope"] = "Actual Popen object/pid/wait/poll on Windows; no POSIX ECHILD claim. Inner original helper owns its three asyncio children."
                write(directory / "process.json", receipt)
        else:
            write(directory / "process.json", receipt)
    assert receipt["started"] and receipt["waited"] and receipt["poll"] == receipt["returncode"] == receipt["final_poll"]
    result = assess(command, directory, receipt, plan, archive)
    write(directory / "assessment.json", result)
    return result


def restore(root, archive, packet, binding):
    errors = []
    attempt = archive / ("restoration-attempt-" + str(len(list(archive.glob("restoration-attempt-*")))))
    attempt.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    try:
        write(attempt / "sources-before.json", sources(root))
    except BaseException:
        errors.append("pre-restoration map: " + traceback.format_exc())
    owned = read(archive / "owned-tests.json") if (archive / "owned-tests.json").is_file() else []
    products = read(archive / "owned-products.json") if (archive / "owned-products.json").is_file() else []
    # A shell fallback cannot recover a vanished Python Popen handle from a PID.
    # Refuse removal while any start receipt lacks a completed native wait/poll.
    for path in archive.glob("*/*/process.json"):
        try:
            receipt = read(path)
            if receipt["started"] and (receipt.get("final_poll") is None or not receipt.get("waited")):
                errors.append("unsettled direct-child receipt: " + str(path.relative_to(archive)))
        except BaseException:
            errors.append("unreadable direct-child receipt: " + str(path.relative_to(archive)))
    if not errors:
        for row in reversed(owned):
            try:
                path = relative(root, row["logical_path"])
                if path.exists():
                    if path.is_file() and sha(path) == row["sha256"]:
                        path.unlink()
                    else:
                        errors.append("retained changed TEST: " + row["logical_path"])
            except BaseException:
                errors.append("TEST restore attempt: " + traceback.format_exc())
        for row in reversed(products):
            try:
                path, backup = relative(root, row["logical_path"]), relative(archive, row["backup_path"])
                if not backup.is_file() or sha(backup) != row["before_sha256"]:
                    errors.append("retained product: invalid original backup: " + row["logical_path"])
                elif not path.is_file():
                    errors.append("retained missing product: " + row["logical_path"])
                elif sha(path) == row["before_sha256"]:
                    pass  # Idempotent shell/always finalizer after successful restore.
                elif sha(path) == row["sha256"]:
                    path.write_bytes(backup.read_bytes())
                    if sha(path) != row["before_sha256"]:
                        errors.append("product restoration hash differs: " + row["logical_path"])
                else:
                    errors.append("retained changed product: " + row["logical_path"])
            except BaseException:
                errors.append("product restore attempt: " + traceback.format_exc())
    actual = None
    try:
        selected = read(packet / "source-map-selected-r4.json")
        actual = sources(root)
        write(archive / "sources-restored.json", actual)
        if actual != selected or len(actual) != 8479:
            errors.append("restored scoped source map differs from exact8479")
        identity(root, binding)
    except BaseException:
        errors.append(traceback.format_exc())
    result = {"ok": not errors, "errors": errors, "owned_created_tests": owned,
              "owned_temporary_products": products, "restored_python_rows": len(actual) if actual is not None else None,
              "scope": "Guarded removal of two owned TEST creations and restoration of one exact temporary config replacement from archived original bytes. No hard-cancellation/process-tree guarantee."}
    write(archive / "restoration.json", result)
    write(attempt / "restoration.json", result)
    return result


def artifacts(archive):
    rows = [{"path": p.relative_to(archive).as_posix(), "sha256": sha(p), "bytes": p.stat().st_size}
            for p in sorted(archive.rglob("*")) if p.is_file() and p != archive / "artifacts.json"]
    write(archive / "artifacts.json", {"files": rows, "count": len(rows), "scope": "All extant files including hidden child work/profile files; manifest excludes itself."})


def run(root, archive):
    packet, binding = archive / "packet", read(archive / "provenance/binding.json")
    results, errors, owned, products = [], [], [], []
    write(archive / "outer-process.json", {"pid": os.getpid(), "parent_pid": os.getppid(), "argv": sys.argv,
          "executable": sys.executable, "scope": "Self-reported foreground outer process; its four direct Popen child waits/polls are separate."})
    try:
        assert read(archive / "initialized.json")["ok"] is True
        identity(root, binding)
        plan, selected = packet_check(packet, binding)
        before = sources(root)
        write(archive / "sources-before.json", before)
        assert before == selected and len(selected) == 8479
        assert [(c["group"], c["mode"]) for c in plan["commands"]] == [("candidate31", "collection"), ("candidate31", "test"), ("compatible_r13_5", "collection"), ("compatible_r13_5", "test")]
        assert not os.environ.get("TLDW_TEST_PRIVATE_PROFILE_NODE") and os.environ.get("TLDW_REQUIRE_ELEVATED_CUSTODY") != "1"
        runtime(packet, archive)
        assert len(plan["products_staged"]) == 1
        for row in plan["products_staged"]:
            target = relative(root, row["logical_path"])
            assert row["logical_path"] == CONFIG_PATH and sha(target) == row["before_sha256"] == CONFIG_BEFORE
            candidate = relative(packet, row["source"])
            assert sha(candidate) == row["sha256"] == CONFIG_AFTER
            backup_name = "product-originals/" + row["logical_path"]
            backup = relative(archive, backup_name)
            backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with backup.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(target.read_bytes())
            assert sha(backup) == CONFIG_BEFORE
            products.append(dict(row, backup_path=backup_name))
            write(archive / "owned-products.json", products)  # Journal before mutation.
            target.write_bytes(candidate.read_bytes())
            assert sha(target) == CONFIG_AFTER
        for row in plan["stage"]:
            target = relative(root, row["logical_path"])
            assert not target.exists() and sha(relative(packet, row["source"])) == row["sha256"]
            owned.append({"logical_path": row["logical_path"], "sha256": row["sha256"]})
            write(archive / "owned-tests.json", owned)
            with target.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(relative(packet, row["source"]).read_bytes())
        staged = dict(selected)
        staged.update({r["logical_path"]: r["sha256"] for r in products + owned})
        assert sources(root) == staged and len(staged) == 8481
        write(archive / "sources-staged.json", sources(root))
        for command in plan["commands"]:
            assert sources(root) == staged
            try:
                result = child(command, root, packet, archive, plan)
                results.append(dict(group=command["group"], mode=command["mode"], **result))
            finally:
                after = sources(root)
                write(archive / ("sources-after-" + command["group"] + "-" + command["mode"] + ".json"), after)
                assert after == staged
                non_python(root, binding)
    except BaseException:
        errors.append(traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        try:
            restoration = restore(root, archive, packet, binding)
        except BaseException:
            restoration = {"ok": False, "errors": [traceback.format_exc()]}
            write(archive / "restoration.json", restoration)
        write(archive / "result.json", {"ordered_results": results, "errors": errors, "restoration": restoration,
              "status": "COMPLETE_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW" if not errors and restoration["ok"] else "INCOMPLETE_OR_UNQUALIFIED_CANDIDATE_RESULT",
              "scope": "Candidate31 then separate compatible5/three genuine memo children only. No product/source/task acceptance or elapsed claim."})
        artifacts(archive)
    if errors or not restoration["ok"]:
        return 1
    return 0 if len(results) == 4 and results[-1]["classification"] == "CANDIDATE_COHORT_PASS_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW" else 2


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("initialize", "run", "finalize"))
    parser.add_argument("--checkout", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--archive", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--binding", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--binding-sha256")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, archive = args.checkout.resolve(), args.archive.resolve()
    assert os.name == "nt" and sys.platform == "win32" and sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 12, 10) and not sys.flags.optimize
    if args.mode == "initialize":
        initialize(root, archive, args.binding.resolve(), args.binding_sha256)
        return 0
    assert archive.is_relative_to((Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"]) / ".config").resolve()) and not archive.is_relative_to(root)
    if args.mode == "run":
        return run(root, archive)
    try:
        restoration = restore(root, archive, archive / "packet", read(archive / "provenance/binding.json"))
        return 0 if restoration["ok"] else 1
    finally:
        artifacts(archive)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
